fr:
Nouveautés :
- Course à pied, vélo et sports à terre : fiche en quatre onglets (aperçu, statistiques, circuits au kilomètre, graphiques)
- Tableau complet : allure, vitesse, temps en mouvement, dénivelé, cardio
- Calories estimées à partir de votre poids
- Apple Watch : le tracé de la sortie est enregistré dans Santé avec la séance
- Apple Watch : cadence, puissance de course, oscillation verticale, temps de contact au sol et température de l'eau quand la montre les mesure
- Corrections et améliorations
en:
What's new:
- Running, cycling and land sports: activity page in four tabs (overview, stats, laps per kilometre, charts)
- Full table: pace, speed, moving time, elevation, heart rate
- Calories estimated from your weight
- Apple Watch: the route of your session is saved to Health with the workout
- Apple Watch: cadence, running power, vertical oscillation, ground contact time and water temperature when the watch measures them
- Fixes and improvements
es:
Novedades:
- Carrera, bici y deportes de tierra: ficha en cuatro pestañas (resumen, estadísticas, vueltas por kilómetro, gráficos)
- Tabla completa: ritmo, velocidad, tiempo en movimiento, desnivel, pulso
- Calorías estimadas a partir de tu peso
- Apple Watch: el recorrido de la salida se guarda en Salud con el entrenamiento
- Apple Watch: cadencia, potencia de carrera, oscilación vertical, tiempo de contacto con el suelo y temperatura del agua cuando el reloj las mide
- Correcciones y mejoras
_note: Apple Watch app (HealthKit): during an activity started by the user, the watch app runs a workout session. It reads heart rate, active energy, step count, walking and running distance, running power, stride length, vertical oscillation, ground contact time and water temperature to show them on the watch and in the activity summary, body mass to estimate calories, and date of birth (for heart rate zones). It saves the workout and its route to Health. Health data stays on the user's devices and is not used for advertising.
